about: Screen texts for *?ST codes (the demodulator status line at the bottom of the meter screen), per *SA mode. The 'locked' codes come from RM-404 (DVB-S 6, DVB-S2 8) and were verified on a TV EXPLORER II+ 1.30 on 2026-11-12, as was SA3/ST0 = 'No signal received'. Intermediate codes are not decoded in the PROMAX software; the texts themselves are listed in the user manual (5.2.11.7) in lock order as screen_messages. When a new code is seen, ask what the meter screen says and add it to labels: {"<SA>": {"<ST>": "screen text"}}. tvxlink-selftest (stage 5) collects the codes it sees.
